entities.name: Methyl chlorinated indole carboxylate
observations: Contains a methyl ester attached to a chloro-substituted indole ring.

entities.name: Tetrahydrofuran
observations: Decoded second organic component SMILES: C1CCOC1; consistent with THF solvent.

entities.name: Base ester hydrolysis
observations: LiOH and NaOH in a THF-containing medium strongly indicate saponification of the methyl ester to a carboxylic acid after workup.

entities.name: Chloro indole carboxylic acid
observations: Predicted product after ester hydrolysis: O=C(O)C1=CC=2C=C[NH]C=2C=C1Cl.
The indole core and aryl chloride are retained; the methoxy group of the methyl ester is replaced by hydroxyl.
